description: The commons' common task list, one task at a time: write what a concept is missing, translate it, check a version blind, revise one with problems, or fix a question learners nearly always miss. Use it when the person wants to contribute to ai.page. Returns the best task for the signed-in person, held for them for 30 minutes, with what is needed to do it and how to submit it.
